newsitem.title: RUSSIA: U.S. Clinton wishes Yeltsin health in phone talk.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Clinton wishes Yeltsin health in phone talk.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton wished good health to Russian President Boris Yeltsin, who is preparing for heart surgery, in a telephone conversation on Sunday, Yeltsin's press office said.
A duty officer said Yeltsin expressed his gratitude for the good wishes and for the readiness of U.S. surgeons to take part in pre-operation consultations. He did not say who made the call.
Yeltsin, 65, said in a televised interview earlier this month that doctors had found problems with his heart and that he had agreed to undergo an operation.
Doctors say the president, who has a history of heart problems, needs a bypass operation to increase the flow of blood.
They have said U.S. heart specialist Michael DeBakey will be asked to take part in a series of consultations due to decide the exact date and details of the operation.
